blocks.html: The main issue here is whether the person intended to say "echad" or "yachad". In the Brit Chadashah/New Testament, when Yahushua stated "I and the Father are one", he clarified his intended meaning later in the same book as "yachad" and not "echad". Yachad signifies a state of unity or oneness, while echad denotes exclusivity or singularity= “the only One”.

In the Brit Chadashah/New Testament, when Yahushua stated "I and the Father are one", he clarified his intended meaning later in the same book as "yachad" and not "echad". Yachad signifies a state of unity or oneness, while echad denotes exclusivity or singularity= “the only One”.

blocks.html: The idea of "one" in relation to Yahushua and יהוה (and all of us) can be summarized as a unified family or collective. Yahushua claimed to be in unity with יהוה, but we solely possess the Greek translation and lack the original Hebrew version to determine the specific meaning. Thus, it is best to allow Yahushua himself to clarify the intended definition. Did he believe he was one with יהוה. In a subsequent section of the book, Yahushua provided a precise explanation of his earlier statement, as he believed in the consistent interpretation of Scripture. He emphasized that our unity stems from our covenant, which encompasses our thoughts, intentions, goals, essence, and connection as a family. He is the paternal figure in our lives, we are His offspring, and Yahushua serves as our sibling. We are all YACHAD with יהוה not Echad.

blocks.html: Yochanan/John 17:19-21 "And for their sakes I sanctify myself (as a Son in Covenant with יהוה), that they also might be sanctified through the truth (that by entering into a Marriage Covenant with me, they will become Children of יהוה by Law, Yochanan/John 1:12). Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word (confess that Yahushua is our Messiah, our Mediating High Priest, our elder Brother in Resurrection order, our Bridegroom through Marriage); That they all may be one (Family as Children of יהוה); as Thou, Father, art in (an Adoption Covenant with) me (through Resurrection to become my Father), and I in (Covenant with) thee (to become Your Firstborn from the dead, SON), that they also may be one (Family) in (Covenant with) us: that the world may believe that Thou hast sent me (in Fulfillment of The Heavenly Scroll, where Yahushua was given Glory as coming King with יהוה in The Beginning)." Ib’rim/Hebrews 10 7 Then I said, 'Here I am--it is written about me in the Heavenly Scroll-- I have come to do Your Will, my God (יהוה is Yahushua’s “God” too!) Mattithyahu/Matthew 6:10 10 Your Kingdom come, Your Will be done, on Earth as it is (written) in (the) Heaven(ly Scroll).
